hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that executes swaps entirely in beforeSwap by routing tokens through Euler Finance lending vaults, computing amounts via a custom AMM curve with reserve tracking. It blocks standard concentrated liquidity (add/donate) and is deployed as a MetaProxy (EIP-3448) with per-pool parameters appended to calldata.
